title: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals
abstract: arXiv:2610.13630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. Inspired by the success of multi-head attention along the sequence axis, we introduce Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR), an extension of AttnRes that generalizes this mechanism to multi-head depth attention, yielding substantial performance gains with minimal additional overhead. MSAR draws stream diversity from sequence context through multi-scale causal convolutions, allowing different heads to retrieve historical representations through distinct contextual views while preserving the integrity of the hidden representation. The retrieved streams are combined through lightweight adaptive mixing to generate the single-stream layer input. translated_abstract: 注意力残差能够在网络深度方向上实现依赖于内容的检索，可视为沿深度轴的单流softmax注意力。受沿序列轴的多头注意力取得成功的启发，我们提出了多流注意力残差，这是AttnRes的一种扩展，将该机制泛化为多头深度注意力，以极小的额外开销带来显著的性能提升。MSAR通过多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文中获取流的多样性，使不同的头能够通过不同的上下文视图检索历史表示，同时保持隐藏表示的完整性。检索到的多个流通过轻量级自适应混合进行组合，以生成单流层的输入。通过保留单流源并按需进行扩展，MSAR无需持久的多流计算即可支持多流计算。
tldr: 提出多流注意力残差（MSAR），将注意力残差泛化为多头深度注意力机制，通过多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文获取流多样性，并经轻量级自适应混合组合各流，以极小的额外开销实现了显著的性能提升。
en_tdlr: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR) generalizes Attention Residuals to multi-head depth attention, deriving stream diversity from sequence context via multi-scale causal convolutions and combining streams with lightweight adaptive mixing, achieving substantial performance gains with minimal overhead.
